These WebP fixtures were generated locally with Pillow/libwebp for the sticker
tests. Both use a transparent 512 x 512 canvas. `static.webp` contains a red
rectangle. `animated.webp` alternates a red and a blue rectangle with two 100 ms
frames and infinite looping. Both are lossless, intentionally exercising palette
WebP decoding as well as animation metadata. No third-party artwork is included.
